title: Lazar only went to the base five or six times

tellings.quote: my understanding through Tim Good who had interviewed him at the time was that he only been at the base five or six times.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S-4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, around 1988 and 1989, is said to have actually been at the base only five or six times. Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, tells Michels he has this from the British UFO author Tim Good, who interviewed Lazar back then, and he points to Lazar's 1988 W-2, the US tax form that records a worker's wages. The point is that Lazar's time at the site would have been short, which bears on how much he could have seen.
